name: Viscounts of the West Kingdom

categories.label: Constructed buildings
categories.hint: VP printed across the top of your player board for the buildings you constructed.

categories.label: Transcribed manuscripts
categories.hint: Sets of different ribbon colours (3 different = 9 VP) plus VP printed on specific manuscripts; enter the total.

categories.label: Castle Leader card
categories.hint: VP printed on the card (5 in the rulebook example) if you hold it.

categories.label: Cleric Bonus card(s)
categories.hint: VP printed on each card you hold.

categories.label: Poverty card bonus
categories.hint: Only if revealed. Most/2nd/3rd flipped deeds (min 1) = 12/8/4 VP; ties split evenly.

categories.label: Prosperity card bonus
categories.hint: Only if revealed. Same as Poverty but counting flipped debts.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with the most remaining silver and resources wins.

notes: Game ends when the Poverty or Prosperity card is revealed: finish the round, then play one more round (player right of the start player goes last). Both cards can be revealed (Divided Kingdom). In games with fewer than 3 players the 8 VP middle reward is ignored. Ongoing townsfolk effects do not apply in final scoring. Tied split for poverty/prosperity: e.g. two tied for first get (12+8)/2 each; not auto-calculated, enter the result. Manuscript set values beyond 3 different ribbons and building values vary per board/card and are entered as totals. Solo AI rules not modelled.
